name: Celestial Disciple
body:
Those who were chosen by the Upper Planes denizens to join their kind, either for their blood, devotion or noble deeds, become real heavenly forces in the lands of mortals.

Requirements

To qualify to become a celestial disciple, a character must fulfill all the following criteria.

Alignment: Any good.
Skills: Knowledge (religion) 5 ranks.
Languages: Celestial
Spellcasting: Able to cast bless. A sorcerer or bloodrager with this prestige class must have the celestial bloodline.
Special: Cannot be a creature with the good subtype or the celestial or half-celestial template.
Class Skills

The celestial disciple’s class skills are Diplomacy (Cha), Fly (Dex), Heal (Wis), Intimidate (Cha), Knowledge (planes, religion) (Int), Perception (Wis), Sense Motive (Wis)

Skill Ranks at Each Level: 2 + Int modifier.

Hit Die: d10.

Table 5: Celestial Disciple
Level	Base Attack Bonus	Fort Save	Ref Save	Will Save	Special	Spells per Day
1st	+0	+1	+0	+1	Aura of good, celestial blood, natural armor increase +1	—
2nd	+1	+1	+1	+1	Ability boost (Str +2), bloodline feat, continued service	+1 level of existing spellcasting class
3rd	+2	+2	+1	+2	Angelic form, lesser (1/day)	+1 level of existing spellcasting class
4th	+3	+2	+1	+2	Ability boost (Str +2), natural armor increase +2	+1 level of existing spellcasting class
5th	+3	+3	+2	+3	Bloodline feat, darkvision 30 ft.	—
6th	+4	+3	+2	+3	Ability boost (Wis +2)	+1 level of existing spellcasting class
7th	+5	+4	+2	+4	Angelic form (2/day), natural armor increase +3	+1 level of existing spellcasting class
8th	+6	+4	+3	+4	Ability boost (Cha +2), bloodline feat	+1 level of existing spellcasting class
9th	+6	+5	+3	+5	Wings	—
10th	+7	+5	+3	+5	Angelic form, greater (3/day), darkvision 60 ft.	+1 level of existing spellcasting class
Class Features
Weapon and Armor Proficiencies

Celestial disciples gain no proficiency with any weapon or armor.

Spellcasting

Spells per Day: At the indicated levels, a celestial disciple gains new spells per day as if she had also gained a level in a spellcasting class she belonged to before adding the prestige class. She does not, however, gain other benefits a character of that class would have gained, except for additional spells per day, spells known (if she is a spontaneous spellcaster), and an increased effective level of spellcasting. If a character had more than one spellcasting class before becoming a celestial disciple, she must decide to which class she adds the new level for purposes of determining spells per day.

Aura of Good (Ex)

The power of a celestial disciple’s aura of good is equal to her cleric and/or paladin level (if any) plus her celestial disciple level.

Celestial Blood: A celestial disciple adds her level to her sorcerer or bloodrager levels when determining the powers gained from her bloodline. If the celestial disciple has level both in bloodrager and sorcerer, she must choose which class stacks with her celestial disciple levels to determine her bloodline powers. If the celestial disciple does not have levels in sorcerer or bloodrager, she instead gains bloodline powers of the celestial sorcerer bloodline, using her celestial disciple level as her sorcerer level to determine the bonuses gained.

This ability does not grant bonus spells to a sorcerer or bloodrager unless she possesses spell slots of an appropriate level. Such bonus spells are automatically granted if the sorcerer or bloodrager gains spell slots of the spell’s level.

Natural Armor Increase (Ex)

At 1st, 4th, and 7th level, a celestial disciple’s skin toughens, causing a cumulative increase to her natural armor bonus of +1.

Bloodline Feat: Upon reaching 2nd level, and every three levels thereafter, a celestial disciple receives one bonus feat, chosen from the sorcerer celestial bloodline’s bonus feat list, or from the bloodrager celestial bloodline’s bonus feat list if she has levels in bloodrager. If the celestial disciple has level both in bloodrager and sorcerer, she must choose which list her bonus feats are chosen from.

Continued Service: The celestial disciple continues to fight against evil as she did before taking this prestige class.

Choose one of the following class features: rage, bloodrage, channel positive energy, fervor, judgment, lay on hands, revelations, sacred weapon, smite evil, or shaman spirit.

Starting at 2nd level, the character adds her celestial disciple class levels to her effective class level in one class of his choice for the purpose of determining the effects of the chosen class feature. If the celestial disciple has no levels in a class granting one of these abilities, she instead can channel positive energy as a cleric of her class level.

Ability Boost: As her body takes on the attributes of an outsider, a celestial disciple gains stat boosts that strengthen her beyond that of an average mortal. At 2nd and 4th level, a disciple gains +2 to Str; at 6th, +2 to Wis; and at 8th, +2 to Cha.

Darkvision (Ex)

At 5th level, the celestial disciple gains darkvision with a range of 30 feet. If she already possessed darkvision, the ability range increases by 30 feet instead. At 10th level, the celestial disciple adds another 30 feet to her darkvision range.

Angelic Form (Sp)

At 4th level, a celestial disciple begins to assume some characteristics of angels. This ability works like lesser angelic aspect. At 7th level, this ability functions as angelic aspect and can be used twice per day; at 10th level, it functions as greater angelic aspect and the celestial disciple can use this ability three times per day. Her caster level for this effect is equal to her effective sorcerer or bloodrager levels for her celestial bloodline.

Wings (Su)

At 9th level, a celestial disciple gains the wings bloodline power, even if she wouldn’t normally gain it (for example, if she has the empyreal wildblooded bloodline).

If she already has wings from another class or race power, or gains them thereafter, her flying speed increases to 90 feet.
